foods containing vitamin C, such as orange juice, to enhance iron absorption.

Impact of Cancer on Nutrition and Hematologic Function 
Advanced age is a risk factor for nutritional deficiency; the addition of chronic diseases, including malignancy, can 
quickly lead to malnourishment. These comorbidities can contribute to reduced tolerance of anticancer therapy, 
impacting survival (Stauder et al., 2020).

medications, infections, or disorders of hematopoiesis. Common concerns are alterations in activities of daily living 
affecting quality of life, decreased productivity, and inability to work. Fatigue is reported as the most common 
troubling symptom of cancer and is directly linked to anemia (Gilreath & Rodgers, 2020). Fatigue and lack of
